body:
## What to build

Kimodo is a real candidate, but no usable local runtime/authorized weights were found in checked locations. The nine import tests use an authored preset with ai_generated=false. Real inference, 16 GiB M2 resource behavior and target joint mapping remain unverified and do not block thin M1.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Choose exact authorized code/checkpoint/encoder revisions and review separate terms.
- [ ] Reconcile documented output joint-count drift with actual checkpoint output.
- [ ] Use only explicitly authorized local resources; no paid API/cloud GPU or silent weight download.
- [ ] If feasible, retain a genuine model run with provenance, measured memory/latency, target mapping and actual playback.
- [ ] If unavailable, retain NOT-RUN; never relabel an authored action as generated.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).

## Evidence and scope

[AI readiness experiment](https://github.com/Derek-X-Wang/nvwa/blob/d74493d/experiments/05-ai-motion/REPORT.md)

Known M0 gap; independent of thin M1.
title: Validate genuine local AI motion readiness and output compatibility
